selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf can establish WHY its reconstruction's threshold statistic is correct — i.e. none separates 'the low-attenuation tail of the lung histogram was recovered' from 'the histogram was displaced until the threshold count matched', and none reports a quantity that would distinguish them on a scan whose reference is unavailable — stakes: this is exactly the failure we measured on real scanner output, where the entire apparent gain of real-pair fine-tuning was reproduced by a single -12.2 HU output-bias change while the reconstructed histogram stayed too narrow (54.9 vs 58.6 HU); a centre that adopts such a model gets an emphysema index that is right on the validation cohort and drifts arbitrarily on the next scanner, and intellectually every published thick-slice-restoration densitometry result is uninterpretable because the two explanations were never separated.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: Step 2a CHAIN. A = decompose_and_delegate: split the monolithic restoration into solvers that each own ONE separately-falsifiable estimand (the through-plane acquisition operator; the reconstruction; the attenuation-distribution statistics), each emitting a structured artifact rather than a hidden activation. O = the per-scan artifact set those solvers exchange — an identified operator with its unexplained-residual budget, the reconstruction's data-consistency residual under THAT operator, and the distribution discrepancy between the reconstruction's lung histogram and what the identified operator plus the observed thick slab admit. B = reframe_as_solvable_object operating on O: the question 'is the threshold statistic right for the right reason' is recast as a FEASIBILITY question — does a reconstruction exist that simultaneously satisfies the identified-operator consistency set and the distribution set, and is the returned one inside both — so the arbitration is solved with existing constrained-feasibility machinery and its violation certificate is the reportable quantity. Without B the decomposition would only produce more numbers; without A there is nothing to be feasible about, because a monolithic network exposes no separable estimands.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: (a) This gap IS the bottleneck: the map from reconstruction to threshold statistic is many-to-one, so a displaced histogram and a recovered tail are indistinguishable to every objective and metric now in use — closing it is what makes any densitometric claim from a restored volume interpretable, and our own measurement (one scalar bias reproducing the whole apparent gain) shows the failure is live, not hypothetical. (b) decompose_and_delegate's move closes it because the reason the two explanations cannot be separated is that ONE model silently holds all three decisions (what the acquisition did, what the anatomy was, what the histogram should look like) under one scalar loss; routing each to a solver that owns it and forcing them to exchange structured artifacts makes each decision separately checkable, and the chained reframe turns their disagreement into a certificate instead of a tie-break. REGRESSION CONSTRAINT inherited from method_lineage: node n12 (EvoIR-Agent / TopoAgent) already occupies 'a reasoning agent composes the restoration pipeline', so the delegation must NOT be tool/pipeline selection by a planner; the solvers must own physical ESTIMANDS bound by a data-consistency contract. Nodes n1 (deconvolve with a nominal SSP), n13/n15 (harmonise to a reference kernel or protocol) and n16 (measure the SSP on a phantom) are likewise occupied and must not be the artifact this pattern lands on.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved leaf tests whether the through-plane acquisition operator has to be treated as KNOWN (or as one globally learned mapping) at all — every restoration leaf inherits that assumption from the shared interpolation/deconvolution ancestor, and the model-based leaves that do relax it (arxiv:2503.21501v1, arxiv:2403.04847v2, semanticscholar:0d3795c98a2a83d53704e5965e08461bc452dfc1) recover physical parameters for their own sake, without asking what a per-scan estimate would have to be accountable to — stakes: practitioners inherit a model whose degradation assumption is unfalsifiable at inference time, so a scanner whose true slice profile or noise texture sits outside the training distribution fails silently rather than loudly; intellectually, the field cannot report an operator estimate as evidence, which is why the same restoration paper can be published for 5 mm and re-published for 8 mm with no cumulative knowledge about the operator itself.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: Step 3b PAIR. The audit is the identity of this gap — its wording is literally 'no leaf tests whether the operator has to be treated as known' — so re-picking would demote the overturned assumption to implicit framing. But under intake.contribution_type = method the audit's honest deliverable is an identifiability statement, not an artifact; controlled_diagnostic_design is attested with assumption_audit_and_pivot and owns the missing deliverable, namely the confound-isolating separation that shows a per-scan identified operator versus the nominal/globally-learned one changes the densitometric endpoint rather than only the image metric — with the simulated-versus-real thick slab acting as the controlled axis, since only the simulated arm has a known operator.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: (a) Connected to the anchor by sequential_pipeline: this leg's output — a per-scan operator estimate together with the part of the observation it CANNOT explain — is the object the anchor's feasibility test is defined against, so the anchor's certificate is vacuous if the operator stays nominal. REMOVAL TEST: without this sibling the obvious reviewer objection ('your certificate is computed under an assumed slice profile, and you measured yourself that a Gaussian profile leaves 12.8% of the thick-slab signal unexplained') is unanswerable, so the anchor's claim loses verifiability rather than merely getting smaller. (b) assumption_audit_and_pivot's move closes it by naming the inherited assumption (the operator is given) and violating it — treating the operator as an unknown that must be identified per scan AND held accountable to the residual it fails to explain, which is the accountability half no retrieved blind-inverse-problem leaf asks for.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved leaf produces, per scan and without a reference, an adjudicated verdict about its own output — the model-based line ends at a residual norm, the agentic line (arxiv:2605.22208v2, arxiv:2606.29763v1) ends at a plan, and neither converts a disagreement between the physics it assumed and the observation it was given into an actionable statement about the number a clinician will read — stakes: in a multi-centre trial the practical question is not 'is the image nicer' but 'may I pool this scan's emphysema index with the others', and today that question is answered by protocol paperwork rather than by the reconstruction; without it, restoration cannot enter a densitometry endpoint pipeline at all, whatever its PSNR.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: (a) Connected to the anchor by sequential_pipeline: the anchor's feasibility certificate is exactly the raw material a verdict must be manufactured from, and this leg turns it into the statement a trial needs (pool / flag / abstain) at inference time where no thin-slice reference exists. REMOVAL TEST: without it the anchor's falsification cannot even be run — the anchor claims its certificate distinguishes a recovered tail from a displaced histogram, and demonstrating that requires the certificate to be read out per scan, with no reference, and compared against the (held-out) truth; a certificate that only exists when the reference exists proves nothing. (b) self_supervised_signal_engineering's move closes it because ground truth is definitionally absent at deployment: the signal must be manufactured from the solvers' own disagreement — the operator's unexplained residual and the distribution-set violation — rather than from a label.

deliverable_coverage: method — anchor gap → decompose_and_delegate ships the runnable mechanism (solvers owning separate estimands, exchanging structured per-scan artifacts), with its chained companion reframe_as_solvable_object supplying the object that mechanism is arbitrated in (a constrained-feasibility test whose violation certificate is reportable).
